channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Gabe Vincent | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Gabe Vincent from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Darvin Ham on Gabe Vincent
item.description:
Darvin Ham on Gabe Vincent:

“Gabe has come a long way. Everything has gone according to plan. Just a few more conditioning boxes that we need to check.”

Darvin Ham on Gabe Vincent, Dec 18, 2023. Source: Twitter @LakersReporter.

item.title: Erik Spoelstra on Gabe Vincent
item.description:
Mike Trudell:Erik Spoelstra on Gabe Vincent:

“He had to come up the hard way. He was with us a long time … each year he carved out a little bit more. He has great emotional stability. That’s a talent … he had his best moments when we needed him most in the playoffs.”

Erik Spoelstra on Gabe Vincent, Nov 6, 2023. Source: Twitter @LakersReporter.

item.title: Nikola Jovic on Kevin Love, Jimmy Butler, Bam Adebayo, Max Strus, Gabe Vincent, Duncan Robinson
item.description:
Nikola Jovic:

“For sure, for sure. I’m sure I’m more ready. More ready mentally and physically. The shot also is going to help me a lot. We have some great players that dominate the paint like Jimmy Butler and Bam Adebayo. If you get a wide open three, they want you to make it. That’s why you have guys like Max Strus and Gabe Vincent, Duncan Robinson, K-Love (Kevin Love) who always are going to make shots and they needed to be great to be where we were last year. It’s something we need and it’s something I’m trying to just think about all the time and be ready and confident. Because when I get it, I know they want me to make it.”

Nikola Jovic on Kevin Love, Jimmy Butler, Bam Adebayo, Max Strus, Gabe Vincent, Duncan Robinson, Sep 25, 2023. Source: Miami Herald.

item.title: Festus Ezeli on Gabe Vincent
item.description:
“To Nigeria, Gabe Vincent is an example of knowing where you come from, having a foundation of hard work and taking advantage of opportunities when you have them,”

Festus Ezeli on Gabe Vincent, Jun 5, 2023. Source: Andscape.

item.title: Erik Spoelstra on Kyle Lowry, Gabe Vincent
item.description:
Brady Hawk:Erik Spoelstra on Gabe Vincent stepping into Kyle Lowry’s spot:

“The whole team feels comfortable with him in that role, and he’s earned it.”

Erik Spoelstra on Kyle Lowry, Gabe Vincent, May 2, 2022. Source: Twitter @BradyHawk305.
